newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Megionneftegaz details Q1 oil output.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Megionneftegaz details Q1 oil output.

text.p: AOOT Megionneftegaz produced 3.03 million tonnes of crude oil in the first three months of 1997, its parent Slavneft said in a statement on Monday.
A spokesman for the company could not give comparisons for the first three months of 1996.
Megionneftegaz is the Russia-based production unit of Russian-Belarussian joint venture NGK Slavneft.
Slavneft, a vertically-integrated oil company, is around 84 percent owned by the Russian government and about nine percent owned by the Belarussian government.
Russia is to hold an investment tender for 19.8 percent of Slavneft at the end of May or in June.
Megionneftegaz produced a total of 12.47 million tonnes of crude oil in 1996. It had earlier forecast total 1997 output would slip to 11.94 million tonnes.
Slavneft said on Monday that first-quarter oil production exceeded the planned target by 128,000 tonnes. It also said the total included 165,700 tonnes output from joint-venture Mekamineft.
Megionneftegaz's profitability from oil output in the first three months of the year improved to 27.5 percent, up 6.3 percent on the same year-ago period, the statement said.
